zh: 合入审阅修正：整齐排列接受 30rem 以上的 2rem 高度档，并在写入前把盒子收进合法档位，含高默认盒子的看板不会写出打不开的版本 3 文件；创建器与内容编辑的数字输入保留负号和小数草稿，隐藏字段与城市字段不再画成通用输入；标签切换的旧答复不再覆盖新选中，拖动、缩放与换排失败会给出可见原因；创建器、内容编辑与改名弹窗打开后焦点进入弹窗，输入法组合期间的 Escape 不关闭弹窗；校园卡背景与图标各自计忙碌并合并绑定，保存不会只带上一张图。组件文档的 CSP 带 sandbox，直接顶层打开时也按 iframe 的沙箱运行；图片解码器推迟到第一次处理图片时加载，缺少平台二进制时给出可见的 503，不再让整个插件起不来；源码面板记住本次写成功的组件版本，应用卡片失败后重试不会卡在 409。内容编辑带上组件哈希核对，CSV/ICS 导入按行建索引不再逐行全表扫描，倒计时按 Luxon 校验日期，样例覆盖有内容的状态。
en: Review fixes: aligned rows accept 2rem height steps above 30rem and normalize boxes before writing, so a board with a tall default box can no longer be written as an unreadable version 3 file. Number fields in the composer and content editor keep a local draft for minus signs and decimals, and hidden or city fields are no longer drawn as generic inputs. A late tab-activation reply no longer overrides a newer selection, and failed drag, resize or arrangement submissions now show a visible reason. Focus enters the composer, content editor and rename dialog when they open, and Escape during an IME composition no longer closes them. Campus background and icon uploads track busy state per role and merge bindings, so saving cannot keep only one image. The widget document CSP carries a sandbox, so opening one as a top-level page still runs it under the iframe sandbox. The image decoder loads on first use and reports a visible 503 when the platform binary is missing instead of preventing the whole plugin from starting. The source panel remembers the version it just wrote, so retrying after applying to a card fails no longer gets stuck on a 409. Content edits carry the widget hash for a version check, CSV/ICS imports index rows instead of scanning every row, the countdown validates dates with Luxon, and its samples cover a populated state.
